title: Stratford Emergency Help Points
summary: Offline guide to nearest 24-hour A&E hospitals, urgent care, hazards, and emergency supplies in Stratford.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 or 112 immediately. For power outages call 105; for gas leaks call 0800 111 999.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- Newham University Hospital: Glen Road, Plaistow, E13 8SL. Travel from Stratford station: ~30 min walk south along Stratford High Street and Plaistow Road, or bus 241 or 473 south.
- The Royal London Hospital (Major Trauma Centre): Whitechapel Road, Whitechapel, E1 1FR. Travel from Stratford station: ~35 min via bus 25 or 205 west along Stratford High Street and Bow Road (A11).

2. NHS Urgent Treatment Centres:
- Sir Ludwig Guttmann Health and Wellbeing Centre: 40 Liberty Bridge Road, East Village, E20 1AS. Travel from Stratford International: ~5 min walk north along Celebration Avenue.
- Newham Urgent Treatment Centre: co-located at Newham University Hospital, Glen Road, E13 8SL.

3. Local Hazard Notes:
- River Lea, Bow Back Rivers, and Channelsea River corridors run through western and southern Stratford; low-lying basin areas near Stratford Marsh and Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park waterways carry surface runoff risks in severe storms.

4. Emergency Supplies:
Pharmacies and large retail food stores along The Broadway, Stratford High Street, and within the East Village neighbourhood can supply drinking water, first-aid items, and emergency medicines.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
